reason: I'd probably use the free visit, but $15 a visit adds up fast on our budget when there are free parks and the library. The gated baby nook is a good sign, but I'm not paying that regularly.
objection: Even with a baby area, will bigger kids be running wild around my toddler, and is it worth $15 every time when money is tight?
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price around $8-10, or a baby-only time slot so I know the older kids aren't there.
